name: Button
description: A clickable control with a short label that triggers an action, such as submitting a form or saving changes.

name: Icon Button
description: A compact button showing only a symbol and no text label, usually square or circular, with a tooltip for meaning.

name: Button Group
description: Several related buttons joined edge to edge in a single row so they read as one control.

name: Split Button
description: A button with a main action on the left and a small attached arrow on the right that opens a menu of alternative actions.

name: Floating Action Button
description: A round, elevated button that floats above the page content in a corner and represents the single most important action on the screen.

name: Link
description: Inline text, often underlined or colored, that navigates to another page or location when clicked.

name: Toggle Button
description: A button that stays pressed in or pops back out to represent an on or off state, like bold in a text editor.

name: Copy Button
description: A small button beside a code snippet or value that copies it to the clipboard and briefly confirms with a checkmark.

name: Text Input
description: A single-line box where a person types a short piece of text, with a label and optional placeholder.

name: Textarea
description: A multi-line box for typing longer text such as a comment or message, often resizable by dragging the corner.

name: Password Input
description: A text field that masks characters as dots and offers an eye icon to reveal what was typed.

name: Search Input
description: A text field with a magnifying-glass icon for typing a query, often with a clear button and live suggestions.

name: Number Input
description: A field that accepts only numbers, with small up and down arrows to increment or decrement the value.

name: Stepper
description: A minus button, a number, and a plus button in a row for adjusting a quantity like items in a cart.

name: PIN Input
description: A row of small single-character boxes for entering a short verification code, moving focus forward automatically as you type.

name: Date Picker
description: A field that opens a calendar grid so a person can pick a specific day.

name: Date Range Picker
description: A calendar for selecting a start day and an end day, highlighting every day in between.

name: Time Picker
description: A control for choosing hours and minutes, either from scrolling columns or a clock face.

name: Calendar
description: A standalone month grid of days with arrows to move between months, shown inline rather than inside a popup.

name: Color Picker
description: A control with a hue slider and a saturation square for choosing a color, often showing a hex value.

name: File Upload
description: A dashed-outline area where files can be dragged and dropped or browsed for, showing upload progress afterwards.

name: Slider
description: A horizontal track with a draggable handle for choosing a value within a range, like volume or brightness.

name: Range Slider
description: A slider with two handles that selects a minimum and a maximum, such as a price range filter.

name: Rating
description: A row of five stars that a person can click to rate something, filling in from the left.

name: Rich Text Editor
description: A large editing area with a formatting toolbar for bold, italics, lists, and links, for writing styled content.

name: Code Editor
description: A monospaced editing area with line numbers and syntax coloring for writing source code.

name: Tag Input
description: A field where typed values turn into small removable pills, used for adding multiple tags or email recipients.

name: Signature Pad
description: A blank canvas area where a person draws their signature with a finger or mouse.

name: Checkbox
description: A small square that shows a checkmark when selected, allowing any number of options in a list to be chosen.

name: Radio Button
description: A small circle that fills with a dot when selected, where choosing one option in the group deselects the others.

name: Switch
description: A pill-shaped control with a sliding knob that flips between on and off and takes effect immediately.

name: Select
description: A field showing the current choice with a downward arrow that opens a list of options to pick exactly one.

name: Multi Select
description: A dropdown that allows choosing several options at once, showing the selections as checkmarks or pills in the field.

name: Combobox
description: A text field combined with a dropdown list that filters its options as you type and lets you pick one.

name: Segmented Control
description: A horizontal bar divided into two to five equal segments where exactly one is highlighted, used to switch between views.

name: Chip
description: A small rounded pill of text that can be selected, toggled, or dismissed, often used for filters or tags.

name: Transfer List
description: Two side-by-side lists with arrow buttons between them for moving items from an available column to a selected column.

name: Tree Select
description: A dropdown whose options are nested in expandable parent-child branches, for choosing from a hierarchy.

name: Navbar
description: A horizontal bar across the top of the page with the logo, main navigation links, and account controls.

name: Sidebar
description: A vertical column along the left edge holding the main navigation links, often collapsible to icons only.

name: Tabs
description: A row of labeled headings where clicking one shows its panel of content and hides the others, with an underline on the active one.

name: Breadcrumb
description: A horizontal trail of links separated by slashes or chevrons showing the path from the home page to the current page.

name: Pagination
description: A row of page numbers with previous and next arrows for moving through a long list split into pages.

name: Menu
description: A floating vertical list of actions or options that appears when a trigger is clicked and disappears on selection.

name: Menu Bar
description: A horizontal strip of top-level menu labels like File, Edit, and View, each opening a dropdown when clicked.

name: Command Palette
description: A centered search box summoned by a keyboard shortcut that lists every command and page and filters as you type.

name: Bottom Navigation
description: A bar fixed to the bottom of a phone screen with three to five icons and labels for switching between top-level sections.

name: Progress Steps
description: A row of numbered circles connected by lines showing which stage of a multi-step process a person is on.

name: Table of Contents
description: A sticky list of section headings beside a long article that highlights the section currently in view.

name: Back to Top
description: A small floating button with an upward arrow that appears after scrolling down and jumps back to the top of the page.

name: Skip Link
description: A hidden link that appears only when focused by keyboard and jumps past the header straight to the main content.

name: Footer
description: The band at the very bottom of every page with secondary links, legal text, and a copyright line.

name: Toast
description: A small message that slides in at a corner or edge of the screen, confirms something happened, and disappears on its own after a few seconds.

name: Snackbar
description: A brief dark bar at the bottom center of the screen with a short message and a single action like Undo, dismissing itself automatically.

name: Banner
description: A full-width strip at the top of the page carrying a persistent site-wide message, staying until dismissed.

name: Alert
description: A colored box placed inline within the content, with an icon and text, that flags information, success, warning, or an error and stays put.

name: Progress Bar
description: A horizontal track that fills from left to right to show how much of a task has completed.

name: Spinner
description: A small rotating circle that indicates something is loading when the wait time is unknown.

name: Skeleton
description: Grey shimmering blocks shaped like the text and images that are about to load, holding their place on the page.

name: Empty State
description: A friendly illustration and short message shown in place of a list that has nothing in it yet, often with a button to add the first item.

name: Error Page
description: A full page shown when something goes wrong or a page does not exist, with a large error code and a way back home.

name: Badge
description: A tiny red circle with a number pinned to the corner of an icon to show how many unread items there are.

name: Tag
description: A small rectangular colored label with short text that categorizes an item or shows its status, not interactive.

name: Status Indicator
description: A small colored dot, green or red or yellow, next to a name or service showing whether it is online, busy, or down.

name: Inline Validation
description: Red text and a red border that appear directly beneath a form field the moment its value is invalid.

name: Confirmation Dialog
description: A small centered dialog asking whether you are sure before a destructive action, with a red confirm button and a cancel button.

name: Modal
description: A window that appears centered over a dimmed page and blocks interaction with everything behind it until closed.

name: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the side edge of the screen over the page and slides back out when dismissed.

name: Bottom Sheet
description: A panel that slides up from the bottom of a phone screen, can be dragged taller, and shows options or details.

name: Popover
description: A small floating card anchored to the element that opened it, holding rich content or controls, closed by clicking outside.

name: Tooltip
description: A tiny dark label with a short explanation that appears when you hover over or focus an element and vanishes when you move away.

name: Hover Card
description: A richer card with an avatar, name, and details that appears when hovering over a username or link.

name: Mega Menu
description: A very wide panel that drops down from a top navigation item, laying out many links in multiple columns with headings.

name: Lightbox
description: A full-screen dark overlay that shows a single enlarged image with arrows to move to the next and previous ones.

name: Coach Mark
description: A highlighted circle around a new feature with an attached callout explaining it, part of a step-by-step first-run tour.

name: Cookie Consent
description: A bar or card that appears on first visit asking you to accept or manage cookies before it goes away.

name: Card
description: A rectangular container with rounded corners and a subtle shadow that groups an image, title, text, and actions about one thing.

name: Accordion
description: A vertical stack of headings that each expand to reveal their content when clicked and collapse when clicked again, often used for FAQs.

name: Disclosure
description: A single line with a small triangle or 'show more' text that reveals hidden content beneath it when toggled.

name: Divider
description: A thin horizontal or vertical line that visually separates two groups of content.

name: Grid
description: An invisible system of equal columns and gutters that aligns page content into a consistent layout.

name: Stack
description: A layout helper that arranges its children in a row or column with equal spacing between each one.

name: Container
description: A centered wrapper that limits content to a maximum width and adds side padding so lines do not stretch across a wide screen.

name: Split Pane
description: Two side-by-side panels with a draggable bar between them that resizes how much space each one gets.

name: Masonry
description: A layout of cards with varying heights packed into columns so there are no gaps, like a Pinterest board.

name: Hero
description: The large full-width section at the top of a landing page with a giant headline, a subtitle, and a prominent call-to-action button.

name: Sticky Header
description: A header that stays fixed to the top of the viewport while the rest of the page scrolls beneath it.

name: Aspect Ratio Box
description: A wrapper that keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height proportion, like 16:9, as it resizes.

name: Table
description: Rows and columns of data with a header row, often sortable by clicking a column heading and with selectable rows.

name: List
description: A vertical sequence of similar items, each on its own row, sometimes with an icon on the left and an action on the right.

name: Description List
description: Pairs of labels and values laid out in two columns for showing details about a single record.

name: Tree View
description: Nested items with small arrows that expand and collapse child items, like a file explorer showing folders.

name: Timeline
description: A vertical line with dots marking events in chronological order, each with a date and a short description.

name: Kanban Board
description: Several vertical columns like To Do, Doing, and Done with cards that can be dragged between them.

name: Stat
description: A very large number with a small label underneath and a green or red arrow showing change from the previous period.

name: Chart
description: A visual plot of data such as bars, lines, or slices with axes and a legend.

name: Sparkline
description: A tiny line chart with no axes or labels, squeezed into a table cell or beside a number to show a trend.

name: Avatar
description: A small circle showing a person's photo or their initials on a colored background.

name: Avatar Group
description: Several overlapping profile circles in a row with a final '+5' circle showing how many more people there are.

name: Code Block
description: A dark or grey box of monospaced text showing formatted source code, often with syntax colors and a copy button.

name: Keyboard Key
description: A tiny bordered box that looks like a physical keyboard key, used to show a shortcut such as Ctrl and K.

name: Blockquote
description: An indented passage of quoted text with a thick vertical bar on the left or large quotation marks.

name: Carousel
description: A horizontal strip of images or cards that you swipe or click arrows to move through, with dots showing your position.

name: Image
description: A photo or illustration displayed on the page, with alternative text and optionally a caption beneath it.

name: Video Player
description: A rectangle that plays moving pictures with a play button, a scrubbing bar, a volume control, and a fullscreen toggle.

name: Audio Player
description: A compact bar with a play button, a progress track, and a timestamp for listening to a sound recording.

name: Map
description: An interactive geographic map with pins marking locations that can be zoomed and dragged.

name: Icon
description: A small simple symbol, like a gear or a trash can, that represents an object or action without words.

name: Logo
description: The brand's mark or name displayed in the top left of the header that links back to the home page.

name: Heading
description: Large bold text that titles a page or section and creates a hierarchy from most to least important.

name: Paragraph
description: A block of ordinary reading text at the standard size, the default body content of a page.

name: Caption
description: Small, muted text beneath an image or field that adds a short explanation or credit.

name: Truncated Text
description: Text cut off with three dots when it runs out of room, sometimes with a link to expand it fully.

name: Form
description: A vertical arrangement of labeled fields ending in a submit button for collecting information from a person.

name: Label
description: The short text placed above or beside a form field naming what should be entered, often with a red asterisk if required.

name: Toolbar
description: A horizontal strip of icon buttons and small controls grouped together above a document or table, like a text editor's formatting row.

name: Filter Bar
description: A row or side panel of dropdowns and checkboxes that narrows down a list of results, showing the active filters as removable pills.

name: Sort Control
description: A small dropdown labelled 'Sort by' that changes the order of a list, such as newest first or price low to high.

name: Search Results
description: The list of matching items shown after a search, each with a highlighted title, a snippet, and a count of total matches at the top.

name: Notification Center
description: A panel opened from a bell icon listing recent notifications with unread ones highlighted and a mark-all-read button.

name: User Menu
description: A dropdown opened by clicking your avatar in the header, with links to profile, settings, and a sign-out action.

name: Theme Toggle
description: A sun and moon control that switches the whole interface between light mode and dark mode.

name: Language Selector
description: A dropdown, often with a globe or flag icon, for switching the interface to a different language or region.

name: Pricing Table
description: Side-by-side columns for plan tiers like Free, Pro, and Enterprise, each with a price, a feature checklist, and a sign-up button.

name: Login Form
description: A compact centered form with an email field, a password field, a forgot-password link, and a sign-in button.

name: Autosave Indicator
description: Tiny text near a document title that quietly cycles between 'Saving…' and 'Saved' as changes are stored automatically.

name: Keyboard Shortcuts Dialog
description: A dialog opened by pressing the question-mark key that lists every keyboard shortcut in the app in neat columns.

name: Infinite Scroll
description: A list that automatically loads and appends more items as you reach the bottom, with no page numbers.

name: Drag Handle
description: A small grip of six dots or two lines on the edge of an item that you grab to drag and reorder it in a list.

name: Resize Handle
description: A small diagonal-lines grip in the bottom-right corner of a box that you drag to change its size.

name: Scrollbar
description: A thin track along the edge of a scrolling area with a thumb that shows position and can be dragged to move through content.

name: Focus Ring
description: A visible colored outline that appears around whichever element currently has keyboard focus.

name: Visually Hidden
description: Text that is invisible on screen but still read aloud by screen readers to describe something for people who cannot see it.

name: Live Region
description: An invisible area whose text changes are announced automatically by screen readers, used to speak status updates.

name: Portal
description: A developer helper that renders a piece of the interface at the end of the document body so overlays escape clipping and stacking issues.
